entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: An outcast of the Vec tribe and duplicitous Weatherlight crew member who guided them to Rath; killed by Volrath.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: Starke's daughter, held hostage to force him to serve the Stronghold.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler of the Stronghold, who shapeshifted into Takara and killed Starke.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, abducted and later rescued.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Arranged to hide Starke at Alaric's mansion.

entities.name: Alaric
entities.description: Friend of Crovax whose mansion was burned down.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship whose crew Starke joined.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane the Weatherlight crew journeyed to.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane the crew escaped to through a portal.

entities.name: Vec tribe
entities.description: Tribe from which Starke was an outcast.

events.summary: To keep Takara safe, Starke helps bring Volrath to power and takes part in Sisay's abduction, leaving a note of clues.
events.quote: he helped bring Volrath to power and then participated in the abduction of Sisay

events.summary: Maraxus catches Starke, burning down the estate; Starke kills Maraxus before he can reveal the betrayal to Gerrard.
events.quote: Starke killed him before he could reveal Starke's betrayal to Gerrard..

events.summary: Starke switches sides and aids Sisay's rescue, guiding the crew through the Stronghold.
events.quote: Starke switched sides, aiding in Sisay's rescue.

events.summary: Starke is permanently blinded by a mind-controlled Takara.
events.quote: was permanently blinded by a mind-controlled Takara

events.summary: The crew flees to the Weatherlight and escapes through the portal to Mercadia.
events.quote: escaped through the portal that took them to Mercadia

events.summary: On Mercadia, "Takara" is revealed to be a shapeshifted Volrath, who murders Starke in retribution.
events.quote: Volrath proceeded to attack and murder him in retribution for his betrayal
